# Welcome to my website !

I am a second year PhD candidate in Economics at the University of Lausanne (HEC) under the supervision of [Professor Kenza Benhima](https://sites.google.com/site/benhimakenza/) (UNIL) and [Professor Sylvia Kaufmann](https://szgerzensee.ch/about/staff/sylvia-kaufmann) (Study Center Gerzensee). I am also scientific collaborator at the [Swiss Institute of Applied Economics (CREA)](https://www.unil.ch/crea/fr/home/menuinst/a-propos/nos-membres.html) where I develop macroeconomic forecasting models for the Swiss economy. I have succesfully completed the [Swiss Program
for Beginning Doctoral Students in Economics](https://szgerzensee.ch/courses/swiss-program-for-beginning-doctoral-students-in-economics/alumni-1) at Study Center Gerzensee (Foundation of the Swiss National Bank).

I hold a dual master's degree in Economics and Business Administration from the University of Lausanne (HEC). 

My research lies at the intersection of international macroeconomics & finance, energy and geoeconomics. I study how financial market shocks and geopolitical events propagate through the global economy, drawing on a range of identification strategies—including high-frequency event-study methods and narrative-based approaches—together with structural time-series techniques to isolate and quantify exogenous shocks and trace their macroeconomic effects. I am also interested in advancing the econometric time-series toolkit itself, refining identification and estimation methods to better capture the dynamics of shock transmission and better forecast.

My experience includes research positions as a trainee at the [European Central Bank](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/home/html/index.en.html), at [the National Bank of Romania](https://www.bnr.ro/National-Bank-of-Romania-1144-Mobile.aspx). I was also economic consultant intern at [Panthéon Recherche](https://www.pantheon-recherche.com/).

Outside academia, I am the author of the economics textbook ["L'Economie en 60 graphiques"](https://www.dunod.com/prepas-concours/economie-en-60-graphiques-pour-reussir-vos-concours) (2nd Edition), widely available in French bookstores and consistently ranked among the top 10 economics student books in France.

Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:viktor.gradoux@unil.ch) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects. \
